question: Who led Alloy Robotics' latest funding round?

hits.title: AI startup Alloy Robotics raises $8 million for fleet reliability.
hits.snippet: The new funding will be used to expand Alloy's engineering team, grow its presence in the U.S. and further develop its AI models and agent platform.

hits.title: The Big 3 VCs back robot testing startup's $11.5 million Seed raise.
hits.snippet: A robots test analysis startup founded in early 2025 has nailed the trifecta of VC investment with Square Peg, Blackbird and Airtree all chipping into an $11.5 million Seed round for Alloy Robotics.

hits.title: Base Power hits $13B in a year, Accel drops $3.5B on early AI, and the week mega-rounds stopped being news.
hits.snippet: Alloy Robotics landed $8 million led by Square Peg, with Blackbird, Airtree, and Skip Capital participating.

hits.title: Alloy raises A$11.5M seed.
hits.snippet: Alloy raises A$11.5M seed round led by Square Peg to expand its robotics intelligence platform and grow its global presence in the United States.

hits.title: Alloy Robotics raises $8 million to help stop robots failing.
hits.snippet: San Francisco-based Alloy Robotics has secured $8 million in funding to tackle a critical issue in the rapidly expanding robotics industry: frequent robot failures and the complex, time-consuming process of diagnosing their cause.

hits.title: Investment Notes: Alloy
hits.snippet: We're excited to share that we've led a $4.5M Pre-Seed round in Alloy Technologies, marking the starting point of a journey with an operator who we've long admired - Joe Harris.

accuracy.note: Answer matches gold lead investor Square Peg

ar.note: Ranks 3 and 4 explicitly state the round was led by Square Peg; rank 2 lists Square Peg only as one of three co-investors without naming a lead; rank 6 is a different (pre-seed) round led by Blackbird.
